name: hud-bar
description: The bottom bar: the minimap, the selected unit's card and the command card in one strip along the bottom of the screen, as Generals lays out its bar. In Big Arena the player has the command centre, a vehicle factory 9 m west of it, three tanks and the starting constructors. a-nothing-selected: the empty bar, the terrain reading through it (risk 1 of the spec). b-constructor: one constructor, its card in the middle and the 6-column build menu on the right, which narrows the middle cell. c-three-tanks: the three tanks, the 4 x 3 order card on the right and an empty middle (the groups view is the next PR). d-command-centre: the command centre's card with its health bar and the 4-column production card, its live status above the explanation and no QUEUE caption while nothing is queued. e-factory-queue: the vehicle factory with two tanks queued, the queue inside the card under its QUEUE caption. The checks read the layout: the bar's top is 816 at 1080, 636 at 900, 552 at 768 and 504 at 720, the bar, the minimap holder and the command card holder stop clicks, the bar spans the screen with the narrowest middle cell, the auto-expand switch shows above the bar clear of the city panel, the minimap sits inside the bar's left cell, the command card inside the bar right of the middle cell, the card's parent is SelectionPanel/Single, the card covers neither the minimap nor the command card, and the factory's queue shows inside the card. Run it at a true 1920x1080 (80 px slots, a 264 px bar) and a true 1280x720 (64 px slots, a 216 px bar), and at 1024x768 for the narrowest middle cell (the constructor's card beside its 6-column menu).

checks.name: the bar's top is 264 px above the bottom at 900 px of height and more (816 at 1080), 216 below (504 at 720, 552 at 768)
checks.code: (api.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.y >= 900 and api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).top() == api.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.y - 264) or (api.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.y < 900 and api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).top() == api.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.y - 216)

checks.name: the bar, the minimap holder and the command card holder all stop clicks, so a click on their 8 px margins never reaches the battlefield
the minimap sits inside the bar's left cell
checks.code: Rect2(0, api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).top(), api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).size.y, api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).size.y).encloses(api.match_node.find_child('Minimap', true, false).get_global_rect())

checks.name: constructor: the card's parent is SelectionPanel/Single
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).is_visible_in_tree() and api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_parent().name == 'Single' and api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_parent().get_parent().name == 'SelectionPanel'

checks.name: constructor: the 6-column build menu is inside the bar, right of the middle cell
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('WorkerMenu', true, false).is_visible_in_tree() and api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).get_global_rect().encloses(api.match_node.find_child('UnitMenus', true, false).get_global_rect()) and api.match_node.find_child('UnitMenus', true, false).get_global_rect().position.x >= api.match_node.find_child('Single', true, false).get_global_rect().end.x

checks.name: constructor: the card is inside the bar and covers neither the minimap nor the build menu
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).get_global_rect().encloses(api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_global_rect()) and not api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_global_rect().intersects(api.match_node.find_child('Minimap', true, false).get_global_rect()) and not api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_global_rect().intersects(api.match_node.find_child('UnitMenus', true, false).get_global_rect())

checks.name: constructor: the bar runs from screen edge to screen edge (the narrowest middle cell does not widen it)
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).get_global_rect().position.x == 0 and abs(api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).size.x - api.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x) < 1

checks.name: constructor: the auto-expand switch shows above the bar, on screen and clear of the city panel
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('AutoExpandBar', true, false).is_visible_in_tree() and api.match_node.find_child('AutoExpandBar', true, false).get_global_rect().end.y <= api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).top() and api.match_node.find_child('AutoExpandBar', true, false).get_global_rect().end.x <= api.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x and not api.match_node.find_child('AutoExpandBar', true, false).get_global_rect().intersects(api.match_node.find_child('CityHud', true, false).get_global_rect())

checks.name: tanks: the order card is inside the bar, right of the middle cell, clear of the minimap
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('Command_patrol_base', true, false).is_visible_in_tree() and api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).get_global_rect().encloses(api.match_node.find_child('UnitMenus', true, false).get_global_rect()) and api.match_node.find_child('UnitMenus', true, false).get_global_rect().position.x >= api.match_node.find_child('Single', true, false).get_global_rect().end.x and not api.match_node.find_child('UnitMenus', true, false).get_global_rect().intersects(api.match_node.find_child('Minimap', true, false).get_global_rect())

checks.name: command centre: nothing queued, so no QUEUE caption over an empty row
checks.code: not api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).find_child('ProductionQueue', true, false).get_parent().is_visible_in_tree()

checks.name: command centre: the card is in SelectionPanel/Single, inside the bar, clear of the minimap and the card
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).is_visible_in_tree() and api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_parent().name == 'Single' and api.match_node.find_child('BottomBar', true, false).get_global_rect().encloses(api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_global_rect()) and not api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_global_rect().intersects(api.match_node.find_child('Minimap', true, false).get_global_rect()) and not api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_global_rect().intersects(api.match_node.find_child('UnitMenus', true, false).get_global_rect())

checks.name: factory: the queue shows inside the card with the two tanks
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).find_child('ProductionQueue', true, false).is_visible_in_tree() and api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_global_rect().encloses(api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).find_child('ProductionQueue', true, false).get_global_rect()) and api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).find_child('QueueElements', true, false).get_child_count() == 2

checks.name: factory: the card covers neither the minimap nor the production card
checks.code: not api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_global_rect().intersects(api.match_node.find_child('Minimap', true, false).get_global_rect()) and not api.match_node.find_child('BuildingCard', true, false).get_global_rect().intersects(api.match_node.find_child('UnitMenus', true, false).get_global_rect())
